claims.claim: Plastic drum for storage of any kind of Liquid
claims.evidence: Photos show large plastic drums, but do not confirm what liquids they are rated for (food/chemical), prior contents, or condition/compatibility.

risks.risk: Unknown capacity/size (liters/gallons). Price depends heavily on volume.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing the drum capacity marking (liters/US gallons) or a tape-measure shot with dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst case for unknown size: assume smaller/standard value rather than premium large capacity.

risks.risk: Unknown prior use/contamination (e.g., oil/chemicals) and whether they are safe for your intended liquid.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of any label/marking indicating previous contents and a confirmation of last use; request a smell/flush test video if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed safe for any liquid (assume may be previously used/needs cleaning).

risks.risk: Condition issues: cracks, warping, lid seal problems, or leaks are not visible in these photos.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the body and lid seals plus a simple water-fill or leak test video.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing inspection/possible minor repairs (assume not leak-tested).

risks.risk: Quantity uncertainty (how many drums you will receive).
risks.proof: Ask for the exact number of drums available for sale and a photo counting them or showing the stack you will get.
risks.if_unproven: Priced per single drum at the lowest-case assumption (no bundle discount).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the capacity marking (liters/gallons) on the drum body or lid.
Confirm last use/previous contents and send any label/marking that indicates chemical/food suitability.
Provide close-up photos of lids, seals, and the drum body for cracks/warping; include a leak test (water fill or pressure/tilt test video).
State the exact quantity being sold (number of drums) and show a photo of the specific set.
response.reason: The photos confirm large plastic liquid storage drums, but key pricing drivers (capacity, condition/leak status, and prior contents/compatibility) are not verifiable remotely from the images provided.
